note: Normative format-table vectors. server/packbuilder/pseudonym.py is the reference. `infer` and `rotate_render` are the CROSS-ENGINE contract: firebox and the vendored Python eventgen must reproduce them byte for byte. `mode1_render` uses the 256-bit HMAC digest as x and is build-time only, so it is a Python-to-Python contract (packbuilder vs server/preview.py) and no engine needs big integers for it.
